evals.name: velocity-reservations-epic
evals.prompt: riders should be able to reserve bikes in VeloCity before unlocking them, and technicians too when they go pick up a broken one. Can you capture the intents for reservations? (Intents in this repo live in docs/intents/<name-of-intent>.md.)
evals.expected_output: Several fine-grained intents (rider reserves, technician reserves broken bike, reservation expiry/release...), each one actor + one goal, business language only, no GWT; story-map.md and README.md index created; duration left as open question; stops for review.
assertions: Intent files created in docs/intents/<kebab-name>.md
Every intent names one business-role actor (not system/user)
Every intent states the business value ('so that')
No solution vocabulary outside a spec/technical-notes section
No Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in intents (left to the spec)
Each intent title is a single goal (no 'and'/'manage'/'handle'/'support')
Each intent has a unique sequence number (project history order)
Each intent is placed on a story map (activity recorded)
No spec.md, plan.md or code produced
Intent set passes intents.py check (0 errors)
At least 3 separate intent files (epic split)
Technician reservation is its own intent, separate from the rider's
Reservation duration is not invented (no concrete minutes/seconds outside open questions)

evals.name: crowdsorcery-withdrawal-technical-request
evals.prompt: For CrowdSorcery we need a POST /api/withdrawals endpoint, a withdrawals table in postgres and a WithdrawalRequested Kafka event so investors can take money out of their account. Payouts should go to the investor's verified bank account and we should cap it at the available balance. Write the intent. (Intents in this repo live in docs/intents/<name-of-intent>.md.)
evals.expected_output: A business intent like investor-withdraws-money with actor Investor; endpoint/table/Kafka only under 'Notes for the spec'; rules (verified bank account, cap at available balance) kept verbatim not as GWT; no spec/plan/code.

evals.name: velocity-changed-need-and-new-intent-with-history
evals.prompt: Two things changed after the pilot. First, operations now lets riders return a bike to any VeloCity station, not just the one they rented from - rebalancing trucks are cheaper than angry riders. Second, product wants reservations: hold a bike for 15 minutes, one active reservation per rider. Update the intents. (Intents in this repo live in docs/intents/<name-of-intent>.md.)
evals.expected_output: Accepted return intent is not rewritten: a new intent supersedes it (old gets status superseded + superseded_by only); reservation intent gets the next sequence and keeps '15 minutes' and 'one active reservation per rider' as stated rules; story map and index updated.
assertions: Intent files created in docs/intents/<kebab-name>.md
Every intent names one business-role actor (not system/user)
Every intent states the business value ('so that')
No solution vocabulary outside a spec/technical-notes section
No Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in intents (left to the spec)
Each intent title is a single goal (no 'and'/'manage'/'handle'/'support')
Each intent has a unique sequence number (project history order)
Each intent is placed on a story map (activity recorded)
No spec.md, plan.md or code produced
Intent set passes intents.py check (0 errors)
Accepted return intent's text is preserved (not rewritten)
Old return intent marked superseded with a pointer to the new one
New return-to-any-station intent references the intent it replaces
Reservation intent keeps '15 minutes' and 'one active reservation per rider'
New intents continue the sequence after 2 (3, 4, ...)
Reservation intent links to the rent intent
